triggers.name: new_or_updated_story
triggers.title: New or updated story
triggers.description: New or updated story in Pivotal Tracker
triggers.help: Triggers when a new story is created in the project. Define the project for Workato to check new stories in. Checks for new stories every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: project_id
input.label: Project ID
input.hint: Can be found at the end of url in project page

input.name: updated_after
input.label: Since
input.hint: When left blank, trigger will start picking up tasks created or updated 1 hour ago

output.name: project_id
output.label: Project ID
output.hint: Can be found at the end of url in project page

output.name: story_type
output.label: Story type
output.hint: Possible values are feature, bug, chore, release

output.name: current_state
output.label: Current state
output.hint: Possible values are accepted, delivered, finished, started, rejected, planned, unstarted, unscheduled

output.name: estimate
output.label: Estimate
output.hint: Can be specified if 'Story type' is 'feature'. Accepted values are 0, 1, 2, 3

output.name: accepted_at
output.label: Accepted at
output.hint: Can be specified if 'Current state' is 'accepted'. Should be current date or past date

output.name: deadline
output.label: Deadline
output.hint: Can be specified if 'Story type' is 'release'

output.name: requested_by_id
output.label: Requested by ID
output.hint: Enter ID of valid requester

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Pivotal Tracker action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Pivotal Tracker connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request
